metadata.description: Name of the existing Log Analytics workspace that Sentinel is enabled on.

RuleDisplayName.defaultValue: Global Administrator role activated or assigned

properties.description: Fires the moment the Global Administrator directory role is activated via PIM or assigned directly, so SOC is notified in near-real-time rather than waiting for a scheduled rule. This is the *detection* half of GA usage monitoring - see LogicApp/NotifySocTeams for the automation that enriches this alert with the PIM requestor/approver and every activity the account performed while elevated, then emails SOC.
